findings.note: Governing output-schema discovery only checks that a file exists and parses as JSON; it never performs the required per-artifact `$schema`/`$id` version check. A wrong-version or substituted schema can therefore be accepted and used for self-validation instead of Blocking with `contract-discovery-failed`, contrary to REQ-002, AC-002, and the design's Discovery contract.

Schema read/parse failures interpolate the raw exception into `ContractDiscoveryFailed`, and main copies that text into the diagnostic detail and Resolver Evidence. An OSError can contain absolute paths, errno wording, and OS-specific text, violating REQ-002/AC-014/REQ-005's canonical Resolver-owned, repository-relative, cross-runtime-stable diagnostic contract. Existing coverage exercises only the fixed missing-file message, not unreadable or malformed schema errors.
